notes.title: Iconic at Gamescom & the Steam Gamescom Event 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to share that [b]Iconic will be part of Gamescom 2025[/b] — both live in Cologne [i]and[/i] digitally through the official Steam Gamescom Event![/p][p]From [b]August 20–24[/b], you’ll have the chance to: [/p][list][*][p][b]Play the newest Demo of Iconic[/b] – featuring the just-added Stages and the latest updates [/p][/*][*][p][b]Meet the team in Cologne[/b] at Hall 10.1 Booth D020g – E021g [/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock an exclusive Discord role[/b] available only at events [/p][/*][*][p][b]Join the Clickmaster Duel[/b] for a chance to win a Steam key in our giveaway[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136104/e9a3c727520b58b837b67add1fce9624801f3a49.png"][/img][/p][p]You can also experience Iconic online as part of the [b]Steam Gamescom Event 2025[/b] — simply visit our Steam page, try the Demo, and see what’s new![/p][p]📍 [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]: August 20–24 · Cologne, Germany 
📍 [b]Steam Gamescom Event 2025[/b]: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38271556-gamescom/"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38271556-gamescom/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting Iconic — whether you’re joining us on-site at Gamescom or playing the Demo from home.                       [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📺 Live Now: Forged in Germany – Iconic Dev Stream
notes.notes: [h3]Join the Developer for a Preview of Iconic in its Current State[/h3][p]Join us as we dive into [i]Iconic[/i], our new take on the horde survival roguelite genre featured in the [i]Games Forged in Germany[/i] event! 🛡️⚔️[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in the development of Iconic, be sure to visit our Discord Server:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/DmRgUnkYUZ"]https://discord.gg/DmRgUnkYUZ[/url][/p]

notes.title: Iconic joins the Games Forged In Germany Event! 🔥
notes.notes: [p]We’re proud to share that Iconic is officially part of the Games Forged In Germany showcase.[/p][p][/p][p]Running from [b]July 24 - 31[/b], this Steam event celebrates the creativity, vision, and passion of indie games made right here in Germany — and we’re incredibly excited (and thankful!) to be included.[/p][p]⚔️💥 From chaotic combat to myth-inspired madness — Iconic is proudly made in Germany.[/p][p][/p][p]🧭 Visit the event page here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged In Germany 2025[/url][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’ve been with us since the early playtests or just discovered Iconic:[/p][p]Thank you for supporting small teams & original ideas. It means the world. 💖[/p]

notes.title: Early Gameplay DEMO is OUT NOW! ⚔️💥
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey Clickmasters — the time has come![/b][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to release the very first [b]public demo of Iconic[/b] — our chaotic, fast-paced roguelite where mythological heroes clash against waves of iconic enemies, across three dynamic lanes of madness.  [b]Try the demo now and see if you’ve got what it takes to survive. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136104/f34514cc9e23a0ad3ed84f2705ff94d0dbe06933.png"][/img][/p][h3]🕹️ What’s in the demo?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Two Missions[/b] to test your reflexes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Three [/b]powerful [b]heroes[/b] to try (with unique styles!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]15+[/b] unique [b]artifacts[/b] & [b]supplies[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Wild [b]synergy combos[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Full [b]gamepad[/b] support[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136104/f34514cc9e23a0ad3ed84f2705ff94d0dbe06933.png"][/img][/p][h3]💬 We want your thoughts![/h3][p]If you give the demo a try, we’d love your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Join our [b][url="https://discord.gg/UTGR4PZjrX"]Discord[/url][/b] — that’s where we’re most active[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a comment on the [b]Steam Forum[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Or tag us on socials and let us know how your run went![/p][/*][/list][p]We read [i]everything[/i] — and your input is essential as we get ready for Early Access later this year.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136104/f34514cc9e23a0ad3ed84f2705ff94d0dbe06933.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for playing — and welcome to the world of Chaos.[/p][p]Let’s make it Iconic. 🚀[/p][p][/p]
